$4stim_tooltip_reset_position_4stim: After the scene ends reset NPCs to where they were when the scene started. The player isn't moved back.
$4stim_tooltip_fades: Fade the screen to black when a scene starts/ends.
$4stim_tooltip_use_intro_scenes: Use designated intro scenes when no specific scene was given. If disabled, any idle may be chosen.
$4stim_tooltip_add_actors_at_start: Show message boxes at scene start to add more actors to the scene. This only works on scenes that don't have a designated starting animation.
$4stim_tooltip_resume_scenes: 0 = scenes running when you save end when that save is loaded, and everyone in them is let go and dressed again (as OStim). 1 = they start again (after the loading screen, one by one), with their speed, auto mode, excitement and what was taken off.
$4stim_end_on_damage: End scenes when someone is hurt
$4stim_tooltip_end_on_damage: 1 = a scene also ends when someone in it is hurt (shot, hit, set on fire): 4Stim's, OStim only ends scenes for a death or a fight, and actors in a scene don't start fights themselves. 0 = only a death or a fight.
$4stim_stay_when_interrupted: Stay put when a scene is broken off
$4stim_tooltip_stay_when_interrupted: 1 = when a scene is broken off (someone died, fought or was hurt), no one is sent back to where they stood before it: they carry on from the scene's spot (stepping off it, so no one is stuck inside someone else). 4Stim's; OStim's "Reset position" sends them back either way. 0 = as OStim.
$4stim_tooltip_transition_lead: When a transition moves on to its destination, in seconds before its set length (negative = after it). Transition clips play once (dyn_Activation) and end with about 0.5 s of held last pose (see docs/SCENES.md), so the default 0 moves on as the motion finishes, while the pose is held and before the game starts blending the clip back to the base pose. If the clip ends first anyway, 4Stim moves on the moment it does.
$4stim_tooltip_use_playback_speed: Scenes' playbackSpeed (OStim's): a speed can play its animation faster or slower than the file's own rate. 0 = always the file's rate.
$4stim_tooltip_lock_scenes: 1 = lock everyone in a scene on the scene's spot for the whole scene: nothing can move them (other NPCs walking into them, furniture or walls, slopes, gravity, their AI). If someone gets off the spot anyway, they're put back ("Scene lock:" in 4Stim.log). 0 = off.
$4stim_tooltip_guard_scenes: 1 = keep NPCs in scenes on the scene: their AI doesn't get to pick its own idles (leaning, smoking, sandbox idles...) while the scene runs, and if a game idle gets in anyway, the scene's animation is played again. Each replay is logged ("Scene guard:" in 4Stim.log).
$4stim_tooltip_target_mode: How the hotkey picks your scene partner: Crosshair - the eligible actor closest to the direction you're facing Proximity - the nearest eligible actor, wherever you're facing
$4stim_tooltip_max_distance: Crosshair: how far to look, and how many degrees either side of your facing still count.
$4stim_tooltip_crosshair_cone: Crosshair: how far to look, and how many degrees either side of your facing still count.
$4stim_tooltip_actor_radius: New scenes: the picker lists the NPCs this far around you to add to the scene (the one the hotkey found is already in).
$4stim_tooltip_male_light_mode: Sets the light for male actors.
$4stim_tooltip_female_light_mode: Sets the light for female actors.
$4stim_tooltip_player_light_mode: Sets the light for the player.
$4stim_tooltip_dark_light: Only use actor lights when the scene takes place in a dark area.
$4stim_tooltip_light_level_dark: How dark counts as dark: the game's light level (GetLightLevel) below this. Fallout 4 reads about 70-75 in dark places at night, so 80 (OStim's 20 is Skyrim's scale). 4Stim.log gives the level at each scene start.
$4stim_tooltip_enable_hud: The in-scene HUD. 1 = on, 0 = off (the hotkey then opens the scene's navigation in the picker instead).
$4stim_tooltip_hud_controls: HUD controls, while it has the keys: Tabs    - Up / Down move in the list, Left / Right change tabs Columns - OStim's: Up / Down move in the list, Left / Right move between the list and the tab buttons (Up / Down then pick a tab). On the Align tab, Left / Right still change a value. Keyboard only: on a controller, d-pad Left / Right only change an Align value, and B goes from the list to the tab buttons (Up / Down pick a tab, A goes back to the list), and B again hides the HUD while the scene goes on; A shows it again.
$4stim_tooltip_theme: HUD theme: a file name in Data\Interface\4Stim\Themes\, without .json. Built in: Color, PipBoy. See HUD_API.md to make your own.
$4stim_tooltip_hud_fade_time: OStim's fadeTime: seconds without input before the HUD fades out (and hands the keys back); any of its keys brings it back. 0 = never.
$4stim_settings_note: Settings changed here are kept in Data\MCM\Settings\4Stim.ini, over 4Stim.ini. Whichever of the two you changed last wins when the game starts. Only in 4Stim.ini: bone names (sPenisBendNode, sLeftEyeNode, sRightEyeNode) and sound flags (iSoundFlags).
$4stim_tooltip_export: Click this button to export the 4Stim MCM settings (to Documents\My Games\Fallout4\4Stim\mcmsettings.json).
$4stim_tooltip_import: Click this button to import the 4Stim MCM settings.
$4stim_tooltip_use_ini: Forgets what was changed here: 4Stim.ini's values again.
$4stim_tooltip_main_key_4stim: Out of a scene, opens the scene picker. In a scene, hands the HUD's keys back to the game, or takes them again.
$4stim_tooltip_npc_start_key: Press while looking at an actor to start an NPC scene with that actor, not involving the PC.
$4stim_tooltip_speed_up_key: Increase speed during 4Stim scene. The default key (numpad +) conflicts with many mods, may need to remap.
$4stim_tooltip_speed_down_key: Decrease speed during 4Stim scene. The default key (numpad -) conflicts with many mods, may need to remap.
$4stim_tooltip_pullout_key: Only usable in manual mode. When pressed during a sexual animation, causes your actor to immediately cancel and \"pull out\" of the current animation. In the alignment menu this changes the increase/decrease step.
$4stim_tooltip_control_toggle_key_4stim: Turns auto mode on or off for the scene you're in or watching.
$4stim_tooltip_tfc_key: Toggle FreeCam during scenes involving the player.
$4stim_tooltip_key_alignment_menu_4stim: Opens the alignment menu (the HUD's Align tab); pressed again, goes back to navigation. Changes are saved at once.
$4stim_tooltip_key_hide_ui: Hides the UI until the key is pressed again.
$4stim_tooltip_use_rumble_4stim: Rumble a controller when an actor climaxes, if a controller is being used.
$4stim_tooltip_osa_up: Key used to go to up in 4Stim menus.
$4stim_tooltip_osa_down: Key used to go to down in 4Stim menus.
$4stim_tooltip_osa_left: Key used to go to left in 4Stim menus. In the alignment menu this key decreases the current value.
$4stim_tooltip_osa_right: Key used to go to right in 4Stim menus. In the alignment menu this key increases the current value.
$4stim_tooltip_osaKeys_tog_4stim: In the alignment menu this key changes actors. Elsewhere it moves between the HUD's list and its tab buttons.
$4stim_tooltip_osa_yes: Key used to activate the currently selected option in 4Stim menus.
$4stim_tooltip_pad_scheme: How the controller moves through the HUD: Modern  - 4Stim's: the d-pad's Up / Down move in the list, A chooses, B goes to the tab buttons (Up / Down pick one, A opens it) and B again hides the HUD (A shows it again); Left / Right only change an Align value. Classic - OStim's navigation: Up / Down / Left / Right / A as OStim's navigation keys (Left goes to the tab buttons, Up / Down pick one, A opens it, Right goes back), the d-pad always reaches the HUD in a scene, and B hands the keys back.
$4stim_tooltip_pad_hotkey: How the controller moves through the HUD: Modern  - 4Stim's: the d-pad's Up / Down move in the list, A chooses, B goes to the tab buttons (Up / Down pick one, A opens it) and B again hides the HUD (A shows it again); Left / Right only change an Align value. Classic - OStim's navigation: Up / Down / Left / Right / A as OStim's navigation keys (Left goes to the tab buttons, Up / Down pick one, A opens it, Right goes back), the d-pad always reaches the HUD in a scene, and B hands the keys back.

$4stim_tooltip_auto_speed_control: Automatically increases speed in player scenes as the actors in a scene also raise their Excitement. This feature is always enabled in NPC scenes.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_speed_control_interv: Minimum amount of time before actors attempt to increase the speed.
Maximum amount of time before actors attempt to increase the speed.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_speed_control_excite: Actors will not attempt to increase speed while all actors excitement is less than the minimum.
Actors will always increase speed while one actors excitement is more than the maximum.
$4stim_tooltip_npc_scene_duration: Maximum duration for an NPC scene if it doesn't stop by end conditions before.
$4stim_tooltip_end_npc_scene_on_orgasm: Despite all other orgasm settings end an NPC scene when one of the actors orgasms.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_npc: Auto mode moves a scene on by itself, like OStim's: every so often it picks a random scene that fits (walking the navigation links when the scene is close enough), sometimes starting with foreplay, sometimes pulling out before a man's climax, and speeds up as excitement rises. Scenes with the player (OStim's SetAIControl) / without the player start in it (1) or not (0).
$4stim_tooltip_navigation_distance_max: If the target scene of an animation change is only this many transitions away the scene will navigate there instead of warping.
$4stim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_always: If enabled, scenes will play out on their own without user input via procedural generation. Note: If you have only used Manual mode briefly or not at all, and never became adept with using it, I STRONGLY recommend you give manual mode a fair chance before using this.
$4stim_use_auto_mode_solo: Use auto mode in solo scenes
$4stim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_solo: Always starts solo scenes in automatic mode.
$4stim_use_auto_mode_vanilla: Use auto mode in vanilla scenes
$4stim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_vanilla: Always starts scenes with no dominant/submissive roles in automatic mode.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_limit_to_naviga: Only choose new animations that are within the navigation distance. This will cause auto mode to always navigate to new animations rather than warping there.
$4stim_use_auto_mode_fades: Fade out in between animation transitions
$4stim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_fades: Fade to black in between animation changes. Will only fade if the new animation is further away then the navigation distance.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_anim_duration_m: Minimum time before automatic mode changes to a new animation.
Maximum time before automatic mode changes to a new animation.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_foreplay_chance: Likelihood for automatic mode to start with foreplay animations.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_foreplay_tresho: Minimum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode stops foreplay animations.
Maximum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode stops foreplay animations.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_pullout_chance: Likelihood for automatic mode to finish with a pullout animation.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_pullout_treshol: Minimum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode goes into pullout animations.
Maximum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode goes into pullout animations.
$4stim_auto_mode_standing_on_floor: Standing off furniture, lying on beds
$4stim_tooltip_auto_mode_standing_on_flo: 1 = off furniture prefer scenes where someone stands, on a bed scenes where no one does, when there are any (OStim requires it).
$4stim_freecam: Switch to free cam mode on start
$4stim_tooltip_auto_fc: Automatically switch to free cam when a scene starts.
$4stim_tooltip_fov: Sets the field of view of the camera when in FreeCam mode.
$4stim_tooltip_fc_speed: Set the speed of the free cam.
$4stim_force_first: Force return to first person after scene
$4stim_tooltip_force_first: Return to first person after the scene ends.
$4stim_tooltip_enable_excitement: Every actor in a scene has an excitement from 0 to 100. It rises with what the scene's actions give them (docs/ACTIONS.md), faster at higher speeds, and only as high as those actions allow (kissing alone stops at 50). Above that it falls back. At 100 the actor climaxes. The HUD's actor meters show it. 1 = on, 0 = off.
$4stim_tooltip_excitement_mult_male: Multiply all the pleasure/second received by male actors by this amount. This effectively lets you choose how long you want sex to last. 3.0 = 3 times shorter, 0.1 = 10 times longer.
$4stim_tooltip_excitement_mult_female: Multiply all the pleasure/second received by female actors by this amount. This effectively lets you choose how long you want sex to last. 3.0 = 3 times shorter, 0.1 = 10 times longer.
$4stim_tooltip_excitement_decay_rate: Amount of excitement an actor loses every second if nothing exciting is happening in the scene. Unaffected by excitement multipliers.
$4stim_tooltip_excitement_decay_grace_pe: Time delay before excitement decay starts after the actor stops partaking in exciting actions.
$4stim_tooltip_post_orgasm_excitement: After an orgasm female actors will start at this much excitement instead of going down to 0. Stacks up with multiple orgasms (after 2nd orgasm they start at twice this amount, etc.)
$4stim_tooltip_post_orgasm_excitement_ma: Maximum value the post orgasm excitement for female actors can stack up to.
$4stim_tooltip_player_bar: Enable the on-screen excitement bar for the player character.
$4stim_tooltip_npc_bar: Enable the on-screen excitement bars for NPCs.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_hide_bar_4stim: Hide the bars when the HUD fades out. If disabled the bars stay up for the whole scene.
$4stim_tooltip_gendered_colors: Change the color of the bars to match the gender of the actor.
$4stim_tooltip_orgasm_end_player: End the 4Stim scene automatically when the player orgasms.
$4stim_orgasm_end_male: End scene after male actor orgasm
$4stim_tooltip_orgasm_end_male: End the 4Stim scene automatically when a male actor orgasms.
$4stim_orgasm_end_female: End scene after female actor orgasm
$4stim_tooltip_orgasm_end_female: End the 4Stim scene automatically when a female actor orgasms.
$4stim_orgasm_end_all: End scene after all actors orgasmed
$4stim_tooltip_orgasm_end_all: End the 4Stim scene automatically when all actors have orgasmed.
$4stim_tooltip_slowmo_orgasms: Add in a few seconds of slow-motion right when the player orgasms.
$4stim_tooltip_blur_orgasms: Add in a screen blur when the player orgasms.
$4stim_tooltip_auto_climax_anims: Automatically play climax animations on orgasm when the scene has one.
$4stim_tooltip_climax_end_delay: Seconds between the climax and the scene ending.
$4stim_tooltip_climax_shake: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.
$4stim_tooltip_climax_blur: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.
$4stim_tooltip_climax_flash: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble.
$4stim_tooltip_climax_glow_size: What you see at a climax in a scene you're in or watching, the moment it happens: the game in slow motion for 2.5 s, a camera shake (strength, 0 = off), a brief blur (on / off, and how strong, 0-1), a white glow at the screen's edges (0-1, drawn by the HUD), and controller rumble. How far in from the screen's edges the glow reaches: a share of the screen's smaller side (0.07 = 7%).
$4stim_tooltip_intended_sex_only: Actors will only use scenes which were intended for their gender. This only has limited support for legacy OSA scenes.
$4stim_tooltip_always_dom_straight: Forces the player to always take the Dom role during Straight scenes. If neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom. Note that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
$4stim_tooltip_always_sub_straight: Forces the player to always take the Sub role during Straight scenes. If neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom. Note that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
$4stim_tooltip_always_dom_gay: Forces the player to always take the Dom role during Gay scenes. If neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom. Note that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
$4stim_tooltip_always_sub_gay: Forces the player to always take the Sub role during Gay scenes. If neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom. Note that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
$4stim_tooltip_select_role_straight: Select the role of the player at the start of a straight scene.
$4stim_tooltip_select_role_gay: Select the role of the player at the start of a gay scene.
$4stim_tooltip_select_role_threesome: Select the role of the player at the start of a threesome (or more) scene.
$4stim_tooltip_unequip_strap_on_if_not_n: Automatically remove strap-ons from female actors when they stop performing penetrative actions.
$4stim_tooltip_futa_use_male_role: Futanari actors will be able to use male animations in addition to female ones.
$4stim_tooltip_futa_use_male_excitement: Excitement calculation for futanari actors will use the male excitement multiplier instead of the female one.
$4stim_tooltip_futa_use_male_orgasm: Orgasm handling for futanari actors will use the male settings instead of the female ones.
$4stim_tooltip_enable_furniture: 4Stim will use nearby furniture to start scenes on.
$4stim_tooltip_select_furniture: A message box will pop up to ask which furniture you want to use. Only affects scenes without a designated furniture.
$4stim_tooltip_furniture_search_dist: High values may increase animation start time.
$4stim_tooltip_furniture_height: Furniture: when the picker opens, it looks around you for beds, chairs, tables and so on, and lists the scenes that can be played on the nearest of each. Types are defined in F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Furniture\ (see docs/FURNITURE.md). How far, in OStim's steps: (value + 1) x 100 units, so 15 = 1600 units (fFurnitureRadius, in units, also works). And how far up or down, in units.
$4stim_tooltip_reset_clutter: Reset clutter objects when starting/ending furniture scenes.
$4stim_tooltip_reset_clutter_radius: High values may cause short game freezes on scene start/end.
$4stim_tooltip_undress: Scene actors take off their clothes and armor, and put them back on when the scene ends (docs/UNDRESS.md). 1 = on, 0 = off.
$4stim_tooltip_always_undress: Actors will always get fully undressed as a scene starts. Mods using this mod's API can force an undress to occur even if this isn't checked.
$4stim_tooltip_undress_if_need: Actors will get fully undressed as soon as a sexual animation plays.
$4stim_tooltip_partial_undressing: Remove single armor pieces as the animations require it.
$4stim_tooltip_animate_redress: Makes NPCs play redressing animations after a scene ends if they need to redress.
$4stim_tooltip_redress: Put it all back on when the scene ends.
$4stim_tooltip_undress_item_delay: Seconds between items as they come off and go back on, so actors undress one piece at a time. 0 = all at once (as OStim).
$4stim_tooltip_undressing_about: Select which armor slots are stripped by 4Stim. These settings apply to both the player and NPCs. Anything covering an undressed slot comes off too, unless it has a NoStrip keyword. Take the names with a grain of salt, as many mods don't use the proper slots.
$4stim_tooltip_expression_duration_min: Minimum time an expression lasts on an actors face.
$4stim_tooltip_expression_duration_max: Maximum time an expression lasts on an actors face.
$4stim_tooltip_disable_eye_look: OStim's eye directions (scene actors' lookUp / lookLeft): the face skeleton's eye bones turned this many degrees at 100, sideways and up / down. 1 = off. Other bone names for other face skeletons.
$4stim_tooltip_look_max_side: OStim's eye directions (scene actors' lookUp / lookLeft): the face skeleton's eye bones turned this many degrees at 100, sideways and up / down. 1 = off. Other bone names for other face skeletons.
$4stim_tooltip_look_max_up: OStim's eye directions (scene actors' lookUp / lookLeft): the face skeleton's eye bones turned this many degrees at 100, sideways and up / down. 1 = off. Other bone names for other face skeletons.
$4stim_tooltip_moan_interval_min: Minimum time in between two moans of an actor.
$4stim_tooltip_moan_interval_max: Maximum time in between two moans of an actor.
$4stim_tooltip_moan_volume: Modifies the volume of moans. Does not affect talking.
$4stim_tooltip_sound_volume: Modifies the volume of non vocal sounds. (e.g. the smack sound of spanking)
$4stim_tooltip_sounds: 0 = no moans or climax sounds. Voice sets are in Data\F4SE\Plugins\4Stim\Voice Sets\ (docs/SOUND.md).
$4stim_tooltip_sound_priority: How sound files play (Fallout 4's audio usage flags and priority, 0-255). Leave these unless sounds don't play; then check 4Stim.log.
$4stim_tooltip_scaling: Disables actor scaling. Warning: This will cause misalignment!
$4stim_tooltip_schlong_bending: Disables schlong bending. Warning: This will cause misalignment!
$4stim_tooltip_erections: Erections (docs/ERECTION.md), 4Stim's (OStim leaves them to Schlongs of Skyrim): actors with a penis are erect during scenes and flaccid at a bend of -10 and after, by their body's erection morph (LooksMenu), physics swap or erect bodysuit. 0 = off.
$4stim_tooltip_penis_bend_step: Penis bend (docs/ALIGNMENT.md), as OStim's schlong bending: each role's penis bent up or down in SoS steps (-9 to +9), from the scene, the Align tab, or the animation. 1 = no bending (OStim's SetSchlongBending). The whole bend per step in degrees (negative if + bends it down; TNG's full bend is about 65 degrees at 9), the skeleton nodes turned, base first (ZeX's segment pivots; one node alone takes the whole bend), each node's share of a bend up and down (TNG's, which curves the shaft), and the nodes' own axis they turn around (0 x, 1 y, 2 z).
$4stim_penis_bend_axis: Penis bend axis (0 x, 1 y, 2 z)
$4stim_tooltip_penis_bend_axis: Penis bend (docs/ALIGNMENT.md), as OStim's schlong bending: each role's penis bent up or down in SoS steps (-9 to +9), from the scene, the Align tab, or the animation. 1 = no bending (OStim's SetSchlongBending). The whole bend per step in degrees (negative if + bends it down; TNG's full bend is about 65 degrees at 9), the skeleton nodes turned, base first (ZeX's segment pivots; one node alone takes the whole bend), each node's share of a bend up and down (TNG's, which curves the shaft), and the nodes' own axis they turn around (0 x, 1 y, 2 z). At a bend of -10 (flaccid), a body that can't go flaccid itself (A-Body, rigid during scenes) hangs this many degrees down at each node: TNG's flaccid pose. Empty: bent -9 instead.
$4stim_tooltip_alignment_group_by_sex: Groups alignment by actor gender. Males and females will have different alignment settings.
$4stim_tooltip_alignment_group_by_height: Groups alignment by actor height. Variations in heights will have different alignment settings.
$4stim_tooltip_alignment_group_by_heels: Groups alignment by actor high heel offsets. Variations in high heel offsets will have different alignment settings.
$4stim_tooltip_toys_enabled: Sex toys (docs/API.md), as OStim's: toys a device plugin registers through 4Stim's plugin interface, driven by the player's scene. Without such a plugin these do nothing. Actions say where a toy goes ("toySlot").
$4stim_tooltip_intiface: Intiface Central (intiface.com): 1 = 4Stim connects to it and uses every device it has connected (vibrators and other vibrate-type devices), no other mod needed. Start Intiface Central's server first; 4Stim keeps trying every few seconds and says what it found in 4Stim.log.
$4stim_intiface_scan: Look for new devices on connecting

Start Intiface Central's server first; 4Stim keeps trying every few seconds and says what it found in 4Stim.log. 1 = ask Intiface to look for new devices when 4Stim connects.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_synchronization_: Changes which actor in the scene the toys are synchronized with, for every toy.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_scaling_type_4st: Changes how the toys' power is calculated, for every toy.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_min_scale: Minimum scaling. When the selected scaling is below this value the minimum magnitude will be used. When it is above the magnitude will scale up to the max magnitude.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_max_scale: Maximum scaling. When the selected scaling is above this value the maximum magnitude will be used. When it is below the magnitude will scale down to the min magnitude.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_min_magnitude: Minimum magnitude for the toys power.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_max_magnitude: Maximum magnitude for the toys power.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_do_peaks: Enable magnitude peaks for this slot.
$4stim_tooltip_toy_slot_do_climax: Activate this toy when the actor has a climax.
$4stim_tooltip_unrestricted_navigation: If checked all requirement checks for all animations are skipped and you can play any animation with any combination of actors. Note: This can lead to some unexpected results in auto mode.
$4stim_tooltip_no_facial_expressions: Disables all facial expressions during scenes. Warning: This will cause clipping during oral scenes! It is only intended to be used for screen-archery purposes.
$4stim_tooltip_log_anim_events: 1 = log every animation event scene actors get in the first 5 s of each scene, to 4Stim.log. For animation authors.
$4stim_tooltip_log_furniture: 1 = log every object the furniture search looks at (with its model path) and where furniture scenes are placed, to 4Stim.log. For writing and tuning furniture types.
$4stim_about_port: A port of OStim Standalone to Fallout 4.
